title: 第1126章 暗流之下第1125章 中天仙域
slug: 聚灵飞升第1126章暗流之下
content_zh:
云来客栈后院的老树下，付荣已经在石凳上坐了许久，手中的茶碗早已凉透。
夜色渐深，南斗城的喧闹声从远处隐约传来，如同潮水退去后留在沙滩上的细碎回响。
老树的枝叶在夜风中轻轻摆动，在月光下投下一片不断晃动的暗影。
付荣放下茶碗，抬眼望向正从院门走进来的云昊。
云昊刚在城中走了一圈，衣袍上还带着夜风的气息。
在对面的石凳上坐下，没有开口，只是等着付荣先说话。
两人之间沉默了片刻。
付荣的声音低沉，带着一种久经岁月的审慎：“情报上的东西都是明面上的。混元九重、混元十重，那些数字只是他们愿意让别人看到的。”
顿了顿：“三十年前我就想跟你说这件事，但当时你刚到中天仙域，我不想让你分心。现在大罗榜的论道还有两个多月就要开始了，该说了。”
“三千仙域的大罗修士齐聚于此，争夺一百个名额。你想想，能上榜的历来都是什么人？
历来都是混元十二重圆满、大罗大圆满的存在。那些明面上写着混元九重、十重的人，哪一个没有隐藏修为？哪一个没有压箱底的手段？
他们未必比北辰玄一弱多少，只是不愿在情报中暴露全部实力。”
“那些来自大仙域的天才之辈，有的低调隐忍，和你一样能越阶战斗。他们不会把自己的底牌写在情报玉简里让人随意查阅。”
云昊安静地听着，没有打断。
付荣说完后拿起凉透的茶碗喝了一口，又放下：“你有没有把握？”
云昊没有立刻回答。
夜风吹过老树的枝叶，沙沙作响。
低头看了看自己的手，缓缓握拳又松开，掌心中暗金色的光芒一闪而逝。
然后他抬起头，看着付荣：“我既然敢来，自然也有底牌和把握。放心吧。”
声音不大，但很稳。

付荣看着他的眼睛，过了片刻收回了目光：“你有数就好。”
从袖中取出一枚新的玉简放在桌上，推了过来：“这是万象楼今天更新的最新情报。又多了几个名字，其中有两个值得注意，都标注了混元十一重。”
云昊拿起玉简，神念探入其中。
新增的两个名字，一个来自北冥仙域，一个来自天罡仙域。
情报中对两人的描述不多，只说他们在各自仙域中极少出手，但凡是出手从未败过。
北冥仙域那位被当地修士称为“北冥寒蛟”，天罡仙域那位则被称为“罡风无痕”。
云昊放下玉简：“这两个人参加大罗榜，是为了争夺前十？”
付荣说：“不止。他们很可能盯上了榜首。”
云昊没有说话。他站起身走到院墙边，望着远处城中连绵不绝的灯火，那些灯火在夜色中明明灭灭。
中天仙域的夜空中没有月亮，只有均匀的暖白色辉光从穹顶洒落，让夜晚的城池笼罩在一层朦胧的光晕中。
过了很久他转过身来：“榜首我暂时不去想。先把前十拿下来再说。”
content_en:
Under the old tree in the backyard of Yunlai Inn, Fu Rong had been sitting on the stone bench for a long time, and the tea bowl in his hand had already gone cold.
As the night gets darker, the noise of Nandou City can be heard faintly from a distance, like the tiny echoes left on the beach after the tide recedes.
The branches and leaves of the old tree swayed gently in the night wind, casting a shadow that was constantly shaking in the moonlight.
Fu Rong put down his tea bowl and raised his eyes to look at Yun Hao who was walking in from the courtyard door.
Yun Hao had just walked around the city, and his robes still smelled of the night wind.
He sat down on the stone bench opposite and didn't speak, just waiting for Fu Rong to speak first.
There was a moment of silence between the two.
Fu Rong's voice was low, with a kind of prudence that has lasted for many years: "Everything in the intelligence is on the surface. The ninth level of Hunyuan, the tenth level of Hunyuan, those numbers are just what they want others to see."
After a pause: "I wanted to tell you about this thirty years ago, but at that time you just arrived in the Zhongtian Immortal Realm, and I didn't want to distract you. Now the Daluobang discussion will start in more than two months, and it's time to talk."
"Three thousand Daluo monks from the Immortal Realm gather here to compete for one hundred places. Think about it, who have always been able to make the list?
It has always been the existence of the twelvefold perfection of Hunyuan and the Great Perfection of Great Luo. Of those people who have the ninth or tenth level of Hunyuan written on their faces, which one has no hidden cultivation? Which one doesn’t have the means to keep the bottom of the box?
They may not be much weaker than Beichen Xuanyi, but they just don't want to reveal their full strength in the intelligence. "
"Those geniuses from the Great Immortal Realm, some are low-key and tolerant, and can fight beyond the ranks like you. They will not write their trump cards in the jade slips of information for others to check at will."
Yun Hao listened quietly without interrupting.
After Fu Rong finished speaking, he picked up the cool tea bowl and took a sip, then put it down again: "Are you sure?"
Yun Hao did not answer immediately.
The night wind rustled through the branches and leaves of the old trees.
He looked down at his hands, slowly clenched and unclenched his fists, and the dark golden light in his palms flashed away.
Then he raised his head and looked at Fu Rong: "Since I dare to come, I naturally have trump cards and confidence. Don't worry."
It's not loud, but it's stable.
Fu Rong looked into his eyes, then withdrew his gaze after a moment: "As long as you know it."
He took out a new jade slip from his sleeve and put it on the table, pushing it over: "This is the latest information updated by Wanxiang Tower today. There are a few more names, two of which are worth noting, both of which are marked at the eleventh level of Hunyuan."
Yun Hao picked up the jade slip and penetrated it with his spiritual thoughts.
Two new names were added, one from the Beiming Immortal Territory and the other from the Tiangang Immortal Territory.
The intelligence did not describe much about the two of them, except that they rarely made any moves in their respective fairy realms, but they never failed when they made moves.
The one in Beiming Immortal Territory is called "Beiming Hanjiao" by the local monks, and the one in Tiangang Immortal Territory is called "Gangfeng Wuhen".
Yun Hao put down the jade slip: "Are these two participating in the Daluo Ranking to compete for the top ten?"
Fu Rong said: "More than that. They are probably eyeing the top spot."
Yunhao said nothing. He stood up and walked to the courtyard wall, looking at the endless lights in the city in the distance. Those lights were clearly extinguished in the night.
There is no moon in the night sky of Zhongtian Immortal Realm, only a uniform warm white glow falls from the dome, covering the city at night in a hazy halo.
After a long time, he turned around: "I won't think about the top spot for now. Let's get down to the top ten first."
